import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
from shapely.wkb import loads
from shapely.geometry import Point

# Query all Conservation land_use_zone polygons
query = text("""
SELECT id, ST_AsBinary(geometry) as wkb
FROM land_use_zone
WHERE land_category = 'Conservation'
""")

conservation_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

for _, row in conservation_df.iterrows():
    geom = loads(bytes(row['wkb']))
    conservation_geoms.append(geom)

print(f"Successfully loaded {len(conservation_geoms)} Conservation geometries")
